subject.title: fix(ci): bound plugin-npm-release git fetch and npm publish with timeout

question: Should the plugin release workflow adopt a 120-second deadline for each Git fetch and a 300-second deadline for npm publishing, each with a 10-second termination grace period?
rationale: These values deliberately change release failure timing and retry/operator behavior; source inspection can establish consistency, but the acceptable operational budget is a release-owner policy choice.

options.title: Accept the proposed per-operation budgets
options.body: Keep 120 seconds for Git transport and 300 seconds for npm publishing, preserving the branch’s focused source guard.

options.title: Adjust the deadline policy
options.body: Choose different documented Git and/or npm deadlines, then update the workflow and exact source assertion together.

options.title: Defer the timeout change
options.body: Leave current job-level timeout behavior in place until release operations have an agreed bounded-process policy.

recommendation.title: Accept the proposed per-operation budgets
recommendation.body: Keep 120 seconds for Git transport and 300 seconds for npm publishing, preserving the branch’s focused source guard.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned to the PR and authored the latest workflow guard and recovery-oriented refinement.
